thread:
jessica (cs): customer reports rerank returning all 0.0 scores and 422 occasionally after payload changes. they flattened their app payload and said it started failing after removing a wrapper field.

arjun (ml-eng): can you paste the exact request body? most of these are query/candidate nesting issues.

jessica (cs): sending minimal repro curl, got a 422 then sometimes a 200 with zero scores.

jessica (cs): ```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "query": "how to reset password",
  "documents": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "text": "reset flow steps",
      "query": { "text": "user query" }  // <-- customer accidentally puts query into each doc
    },
    {
      "id": "d2",
      "text": "password policy",
      "passages": [{"text":"step 1"}]
    }
  ],
  "candidates": ["d1", "d2"]
}
```

arjun (ml-eng): ah — the nested `query` inside each document is shadowing/merging with the top-level "query" key in our parser. when the server flattens or validates it, it can treat the doc-level `query` as candidate text or confuse the schema, leading to either a validation 422 or a rerank where candidate text is empty -> 0.0 scores.

kevin (sre): also saw this pattern when clients migrate from older SDKs that auto-wrap search context into docs. our validation currently allows arbitrary objects in docs.metadata which made this slip through.

jessica (cs): customer said they did a JSON->proto flattening step in their pipeline. any quick mitigation we can tell them?

arjun (ml-eng): ask them to remove `query` from inside each document and only send the top-level `query` (or rename the field under doc metadata). Example fix:

jessica (cs): ```
{
  "query": "how to reset password",
  "documents": [
    {"id":"d1", "text":"reset flow steps"},
    {"id":"d2", "text":"password policy", "passages":[{"text":"step 1"}]}
  ],
  "candidates": ["d1","d2"]
}
```

arjun (ml-eng): if they need per-doc query context, recommend moving it to `documents[].metadata.query_context` (rename) so it won't collide with top-level fields. we'll add a validation rule to reject `documents[].query` to avoid accidental collisions. filing a follow-up ticket.

kevin (sre): created incident-notes: rerank-schema-shadowing-309511, flagging for potential 422 spike.

deploy-bot: deployment started for schema validation rule (canary) — rolled to 10% infra. :gear:

jessica (cs): thanks — forwarding fix suggestion to customer and asking for a test after they remove the nested `query`. will update this thread with repro logs. :thumbsup:
